failure_diagnosis.observed: The original HOME baseline was com.google.android.googlesdksetup. Android later rejected restoring it because its required MAIN/HOME activity was no longer eligible.
failure_diagnosis.classification: Harness baseline captured during first-boot setup; no failing application route was observed.

11-24 11:52:36.390   674  1158 E RoleControllerServiceImpl: Package does not qualify for the role, package: com.google.android.googlesdksetup, role: android.app.role.HOME

failure_diagnosis.qualification: The interval brackets the booted message and first app installation. The original run did not capture provisioning settings or query HOME eligibility before recording the role, so exact setup-completion timing is not observed.
failure_diagnosis.source_contract: FerroUI emu_start waits for sys.boot_completed and the package manager; smoke-android.sh then immediately snapshots HOME. Neither waits for provisioning and a stable eligible HOME holder.
failure_diagnosis.minimal_correction: Before recording the restoration baseline, wait for device/user setup completion and two stable HOME snapshots whose authoritative holder resolves to an enabled MAIN/HOME component. Preserve exact restoration and private-AVD identity guards.
failure_diagnosis.correction_validation: A follow-up harness change passes local parser fixtures; no corrected emulator result is claimed by this E record.
